title: Google\Cloud\Memcache\V1\OperationMetadata
name: OperationMetadata
description: Represents the metadata of a long-running operation.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.create_time
params.description: Output only. Time when the operation was created.

params.name: data.end_time
params.description: Output only. Time when the operation finished running.

params.name: data.target
params.description: Output only. Server-defined resource path for the target of the operation.

params.name: data.verb
params.description: Output only. Name of the verb executed by the operation.

params.name: data.status_detail
params.description: Output only. Human-readable status of the operation, if any.

params.name: data.cancel_requested
params.description: Output only. Identifies whether the user has requested cancellation of the operation. Operations that have successfully been cancelled have [Operation.error][] value with a [google.rpc.Status.code][google.rpc.Status.code] of 1, corresponding to Code.CANCELLED.

params.name: data.api_version
params.description: Output only. API version used to start the operation.
